content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "पीडितम्. But there is no authority for this meaning. It means placed", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "in a dangerous or difficult position. Comp. Bhaṭṭi. VI., 88. शर्मदं", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "माहानिं दूनं विषमस्थः कपिद्विपम् ॥ प्रायुङ्क्त &c. where one commentary says", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "विषमे दुर्गपर्वते तिष्ठतीति विषमस्थः and the other विषमे कृच्छ्रे तिष्ठतीति. Com-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 5, "text": "pare also Mṛichchhakatika p. 340 (Calc. Ed.), or Bhagavadgîtâ", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "II., 2 where S'ankara renders it by सभयस्थाने. The idea is that", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "in whatever place and in whatever circumstances one may be", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "placed, the merit accumulated in a previous birth is always ready", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "with its help.—Upajâti.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XCVIII.—हित = well-wisher. Comp. Kirâta I., 4 सत्क्रिया = good", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "conduct, as in S'âkuntala शकुन्तला मूर्तिमती च सत्क्रिया. व्यसनैः = constant", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "application, perseverance. With the reading वक्रिकाम् which would", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "seem to mean “crookedness”, the meaning of the Stanza must be", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "“that which makes wicked men of good ones” &c. This is also the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "meaning according to Râmarshi with the reading चक्रिकाम् which", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "he interprets to be either सरस्वती or लक्ष्मी, though he does not", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "show how it suits the meaning to interpret चक्रिका as सरस्वती.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "Possibly it may refer to the power of speech “to make the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "worse appear the better reason.” वक्रेण विनास्मिन्युगे फलं न भवति (com-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 12, "text": "mentary). With सत्क्रिया of course the meaning is “that which", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "makes good men of wicked ones.”—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. XCIX.—कार्यजातम् = कार्यस्वरूपम् (Râmarshi) which in its", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "ordinary sense seems scarcely to be correct; it means the collec-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 3, "text": "tion of acts i. e. all acts whatever; a very common expression,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "compare भूतजातम् Uttararâmacharita 143 and see the Kosha cited", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "under Raghu V., 1 by Mallinâtha. आविपत्तेः = up to the time", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "of death. विपाक = result, oftener bad than good result.—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "Mâlinî.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. C.—तिलखली = तिलपिष्टक Râmarshi. खल is given in the Medi-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 2, "text": "nî Kosha as meaning कल्क i. e. the refuse after the oil is extract-", "end": "hyphen"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "26", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r2", "type": "running_header", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "NOTES.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": "Notes", "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "97", "label": "St. XCVII.", "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "98", "label": "St. XCVIII.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "99", "label": "St. XCIX.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r5"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "100", "label": "St. C.", "open_start": false, "open_end": true, "children": ["r6"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
